doc: Known colour-doctrine debt the accent audit (dev/selftest/accent_audit.gd) tolerates: an accent ink on a layer palette.json does not allow it on, up to max_px at ppm px/m in the selftest junction (seed 91). Any offender not listed here, or above its max_px, fails the selftest evidence (tools/selftest/run.mjs). A row is debt, not a permission: it names the source and the lane that pays it off, and is deleted when the source is fixed.
